description: Blueleaf Tubers Level 26 Grab a Crate with Holes. Grab a Snufflenose Command Stick. Grab and read the Snufflenose Owner's Manual. In Razorfen Kraul, use the Crate with Holes to summon a Snufflenose Gopher, and use the Command Stick on the gopher to make it search for Tubers. Bring 6 Blueleaf Tubers, the Snufflenose Command Stick and the Crate with Holes to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet. Requirements: - Blueleaf Tuber x 6 - Crate With Holes - Snufflenose Owner's Manual - Snufflenose Command Stick
name: Blueleaf Tubers
